str_min_conf_the_minimum_confidence_help:
Min. Conf.: the minimum confidence, the lowest score a detection needs to be kept (CONFIDENCE).
Default BirdSuite (V3 model): {def}
Default BirdNET V2.4: 0.70
Range: 0.01 to 0.99
Higher: fewer detections, more reliable; quiet or distant birds are missed.
Lower: more detections, more of them wrong (the manual confidence of the species replaces it for that species).
str_min_prob_the_minimum_help:
Min. Prob.: the minimum probability of occurrence at the location; species below it this week are left out (SF_THRESH).
Default BirdSuite (V3 model): {def}
Default BirdNET V2.4: 0.03
Range: 0.0005 to 0.99
Higher: only the species expected here (the Whitelist bypasses it).
Lower: more species allowed, rare and vagrant ones too, with more errors.
str_only_species_detected_at_most_n_help: Only species detected at most N times from yesterday 00:00 until now
str_only_species_with_no_detection_help: Only species with no detection in the N days before today (the rare species of the Latest page)
str_only_the_detections_worth_a_help: Only the detections worth a look: confidence or probability of occurrence at the location below the value
str_open_the_latest_page_with_this_help: Open the Latest page with this view, count, period and filter values
str_overlap_seconds_the_3_s_help:
Overlap: seconds the 3 s analysis windows overlap (OVERLAP).
Default BirdSuite (V3 model): {def} s
Default BirdNET V2.4: 0 s
Range: 0 to 2.9 s
Higher: calls on a window edge are caught; more CPU and repeated detections of one call.
Lower: fewer windows; 0 = side by side, the fastest.
str_period_searched_by_the_filters_help: Period searched by the filters and the search (the list without them is always the latest detections)
str_rec_length_seconds_of_each_help:
Rec. Length: seconds of each recorded and analysed file (RECORDING_LENGTH); a change restarts the recording service.
Default BirdSuite (V3 model): {def} s
Default BirdNET V2.4: 15 s
Range: 3 to 60 s
Higher: fewer files; a detection shows up later.
Lower: detections appear sooner; more files, a little more work per minute.
str_recordings_waiting_for_the_help: Recordings waiting for the analysis (behind real time), and the time of the recording the sonogram shows
str_saved_applied_from_the_next_help: Saved: applied from the next recording
str_show_or_hide_the_live_spectrogram: Show or hide the live sonogram
str_sigm_sens_bends_the_model_and_help:
Sigm. Sens.: bends the model's scores before the minimum confidence is applied (SENSITIVITY).
Default BirdSuite (V3 model): {def}
Default BirdNET V2.4: 1.25
Range: 0.5 to 1.5
Higher: scores rise, so more detections and more false ones.
Lower: scores fall, so fewer detections.
